method: CPU geometry only; fractions use pixel centres and solid depth occlusion, not lighting/HUD. Clearance is the minimum sampled hull-to-terrain gap and enclosing-hull-sphere-to-prop gap. No runtime tuning changed.

transforms.transform: Whole existing east prop via def.scale and def.yOffsetM, Props.replace; poses/cameras and both POIs remain fixed at baseline world positions.
transforms.route: Prior fixed-depth 8 m sampled route, radius hullRadius+4, ending at mission scan cap; not a piloted 3D path.
transforms.scan: East-prop collider overlap with fixed authored 36 m and Arcade-resolved 100 m scan spheres at both gallery contacts; overlap does not imply entire scan region blocked.

negativeClearance: -1 is overlap of the conservative enclosing hull sphere; not a measured penetration depth.
